checks.detail: Correct fixture passed, injected fault failed, repaired fixture passed.
Icarus 12 compilation and simulation succeeded; 112 output comparisons.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
Pre-reset initial direction and unknown bump inputs are not specified by the original problem.
No synthesis or board work performed.
implementation: Two-state Moore FSM with one-bit enum, positive-edge clock, positive-edge asynchronous active-high reset to left; exact original ports; no extra latency.
verification_coverage: All bump combinations in both directions, opposite-side bump hold, repeated simultaneous bumps, between-edge Moore stability, off-edge asynchronous reset, held reset priority, release and post-reset operation.
static_review: Single sequential state driver, complete combinational next-state assignment, explicit enum if/else assignments, no arithmetic or additional modules. Initial snapshot preserved before checks.
